text: St Mirren, who finished sixth in the top flight, at home to Ayr United, who lost in the promotion play-offs, is another potential top-place showdown on 27 July.

St Mirren, competing in the Scottish Premiership, played to a goalless draw against League 1 champions Arbroath away from home and forfeited the bonus point after being defeated in the penalty shootout of the Premier Sports Cup.

On July 27, another potential showdown for the top spot will feature St Mirren, who ended up sixth in the premier league, facing Ayr United, a team that was defeated in the promotion play-offs, at home.
Next Saturday, St Mirren will begin their League Cup campaign by playing away against Arbroath, following a Tuesday friendly match against Airdrie.
Scottish Premiership St Mirren were held to a goalless draw away to League 1 champions Arbroath and missed out on the bonus point by losing the penalty shootout in the Premier Sports Cup.
